amendment_reason: explicit user instruction to halve endpoint cost
amendment_selection: first 640 reactions in the original outcome-blind salted selection order; no model output used
amendment_timing: after six primary trajectories trained, before any confirmation-panel inference or outcome inspection

evaluator_optimization_gate.retain_if: median wall speedup at least 1.03 across old Native/Released/Paper rank-8 checkpoints with exact equality of every ordered beam and derived field

frozen_audit_independence: probe splits and audit protocol are frozen before any confirmation outcome; the audit rejects confirmation-panel overlap and cannot influence confirmation arms, stopping, or endpoint
futility_rule: after all three arms finish on both primary seeds, stop iff Released and Paper are each nonpositive versus Native in both seeds
multiplicity: report raw contrast inference and Holm adjustment across the two prespecified treatment contrasts
otherwise: run both contingent paired seeds for all three arms
primary_endpoint: official five-view exact top-1, beam 10, reciprocal-rank aggregation
uncertainty: seed t interval explicitly labeled fragile
